about_the_game:
Game Name

Angel Roulette: Survival Escape + Tabletop Showdown

New Overview

Angel Roulette has evolved into a hardcore dual-mode experience, blending multiplayer tabletop roulette tactics with third-person survival escape.

In the classic turn-based tabletop showdown, strategy and luck intertwine as you outsmart opponents. In the new "Survival Escape" mode, you'll venture into perilous restricted zones, face intelligent infected enemies, and utilize firearms, stealth, crafting, and execution systems to survive against all odds. Two distinct paths share one goal: earn points, climb the global leaderboards, and become the true "Roulette Champion."

Core Dual-Mode Gameplay

  • Mode 1: Survival Escape (New)

    • Third-Person Action-Shooter Experience:​ Use realistic firearms like pistols, rifles, shotguns, crossbows, along with various melee weapons and finishers to handle threats.

    • In-Depth Survival Systems:​ Scavenge resources, manage your backpack, and craft items to plan your escape from infected zones.

    • Smart Enemy AI:​ Infected enemies can chase, pounce, throw objects, and even use weapons, featuring sharp hearing and diverse behaviors.

    • Handicraft & Crafting:​ Use collected parts and resources to create weapon upgrades, medical items, explosives, etc., boosting survival chances.

  • Mode 2: Roulette Duel (Classic, Enhanced)

    • Turn-Based Tabletop Life-or-Death Duel:​ Choose your weapon – revolvers, shotguns, rifles, or even the playful "Slap" – where every shot counts.

    • Strategic Items & Skill Cards:​ Use special items like Medkits, Grenades, Prophet's Rings, or play unique skill cards at critical moments to turn the tide.

    • Single-Player & Multiplayer Competition:​ Practice solo or compete online globally, with records directly impacting global leaderboards.

Personalization & Progression

  • Character Customization:​ Earn resources through battle to unlock hundreds of apparel, accessory, and physique options, creating a unique avatar.

  • Achievements & Leaderboards:​ Victories in both modes grant experience and points, boosting your world ranking and proving your prowess.

Story Background

Thrust into the crazy reality show "Wheel of Fate," where prizes dance with death, you must outmaneuver rivals in the roulette duel while undertaking survival challenges in infected zones. Only the wisest and bravest can claim the rewards and freedom.

Feature Summary

  • Dual Modes, Free Switch:​ Hardcore survival shooter and strategic tabletop duels.

  • Rich Arsenal & Action Systems:​ Firearms, melee, executions, crafting.

  • Highly Intelligent Enemies:​ Infected possess hearing, coordination, weapon use.

  • Deep Customization:​ Character appearance, weapon loadouts, tactical skills.

  • Global Competition:​ Single/Multiplayer versus, real-time leaderboard contests.

Ready for the dual challenge? Will you be the strategic master at the roulette table, or the survival expert in the contaminated zone? Join Angel Roulette now and choose your path.

Welcome to wishlist the game and stay tuned for updates. Thank you for your interest and support.

content_descriptors.notes: In this game, the player can use guns to shoot enemies, can use cold weapons to attack enemies, can use explosives and set traps.  The same computer-controlled enemy will do the same thing to the player.  There are monsters in the game that attack and bite the player.  Players can practice yoga movements and fitness movements in the yoga gym, players can practice dance movements in the dance studio, players can change clothes in the changing room and customize the figure of the character.
